name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
summary: Saint Kitts and Nevis has no forced heirship in the sources read. Nevis offers international trusts that foreign heirship rules cannot attack, and a Multiform Foundation. The Hague Trusts Convention is not in force.
foreign_law_note: No source read states the federation's conflict rule for a foreign national's estate. Common-law rule: movables follow the law of the domicile, land follows local law. Not confirmed in local statute for this jurisdiction.
trust_note: Not in the HCCH status table. The Nevis regulator says an international trust cannot be declared void because of forced heirship rules of the settlor's domicile. Foundations: Nevis Multiform Foundations Ordinance, Cap. 7.08(N) (Ordinance 2 of 2004, amended 2011), with the same protection. IFC Review also lists St Kitts as having foundation legislation (not named).
open_questions: Succession law on St Kitts and Nevis themselves (wills, family provision) was not read.
Name of the Nevis trust ordinance and any St Kitts foundation act not confirmed.
